title: Dollar-factor concentration-gated cross-pair short-horizon reversal on staged daily prices

mechanism.paragraph: Slow actor: global asset allocators and FX overlay managers running multi-day USD-book rebalancing under observation and transaction frictions (staggered, infrequent adjustment - not fast dealers). A dominant share of bilateral USD-pair variance is a common dollar factor; when that factor explains an unusually large share of recent cross-pair co-movement, the common move has outrun the diversification of slow books - heterogeneous managers have chased the same aggregate USD swing and only gradually re-diversify. The proposed exploitable residue: in the high-concentration state the common component mean-reverts over the following week, so fading each pair's own trailing 10-decision-day move earns after-cost alpha across the board; when concentration is ordinary, recent moves are idiosyncratic (currency-specific regimes) and the same fade has no edge. Information source is PURELY price-derived cross-pair co-movement on staged daily snapshots - no calendar, no macro series, no print content.
mechanism.forced_or_slow_actor: Institutional USD-book managers with observation/transaction-cost frictions (slow actors) whose staggered rebalancing overshoots the common dollar factor before re-diversifying.
mechanism.why_it_should_exist: Factor concentration is the observable footprint of crowded one-sided USD positioning by slow books; crowding is precisely the state in which subsequent reversal premium (liquidity provision against exhausted one-sided flows) is paid.
literature_lineage: Lustig, H., Roussanov, N. and Verdelhan, A. (2011), 'Common Risk Factors in Currency Markets', Review of Financial Studies - the dollar factor as the first principal component of USD-pair returns.
Verdelhan, A. (2018), 'The Share of Systematic Variation in Bilateral Exchange Rates', Journal of Finance - the common dollar factor's time-varying share of bilateral variance.
Nagel, S. (2012), 'Evaporating Liquidity', Review of Financial Studies - reversal premium as compensation to slow liquidity providers after one-sided flows.
Menkhoff, L., Sarno, L., Schmeling, M. and Schrimpf, A. (2012), 'Currency Momentum Strategies', Journal of Financial Economics - global (non-carry) FX factors and short-horizon return structure.
mechanism.novelty_statement: The information source is the time-varying cross-pair co-movement structure (PCA concentration share) of the 7 staged USD pairs - a price-derived second-moment observable with NO conditioning calendar, NO macro input, NO rates input and NO session shape. It is not release-window avoidance (no calendar exists here), not carry (no differentials), not a session family (daily clock), not commodity-bloc risk-off (the state is a PCA share, not an event class). D2 must measure |rho| <= 0.20 against the full forbidden inventory, including the reversal-adjacent shapes.

prices.file: inherited staged daily snapshots for all 7 pairs, byte-verified per research/control/forex_free_v6_run/p2_data_authority_v6.json (manifest sha256 fe2155c0ef51bcac32262ebaf1c7d98fc724727eca1dda8b6644012ad854c460, 156 files, V4/V5 byte-identity chain)
prices.granularity: daily decision closes only; the 4h snapshots are NOT used by this proposal
derived_quantities: per-pair daily log returns at the 16:00 America/New_York decision close
7x7 correlation matrix of the trailing 20 returns
first-eigenvalue share of the correlation matrix
per-pair trailing 10-day cumulative returns and 20-day volatilities

information_source.clocks: NONE - this proposal conditions on nothing but staged prices; the conditioning clocks file is not consulted for entries

availability_semantics.rule: price-derived: a state at decision close t uses only closes at or before t (trailing windows, rolling percentile reference) - PIT by construction
availability_semantics.missing_days_fail_closed: if ANY of the 7 pairs lacks a decision close inside the trailing 20-decision-day window at t, NO new entries are formed at t (fail-closed; the state is undefined rather than computed on a shrunken cross-section)
availability_semantics.no_asserted_timestamps: no availability stamp of any kind is consumed (P-1 trivially satisfied; nothing in this proposal is calendar-aware)

universe.excluded: NONE - every pair enters identically as a leg of the cross-pair co-movement measure; evidenced reason: all 7 pairs are staged, byte-verified daily snapshots (p2_data_authority_v6.json), and the dollar-factor mechanism requires the full 7-pair cross-section to define concentration

clock.decision_instant: daily 16:00 America/New_York, DST-correct (20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST), per clocks-file clock_semantics
clock.decision_day_convention: weekday rule, FX 24/5; no holiday calendar is in evidence and none is assumed

features_and_lags.notation: decision day t; pair i in the 7-pair universe; r_{i,t} = ln(C_{i,t} / C_{i,t-1})
features_and_lags.pc1_share_s_t: lambda_1 / sum(lambda) of the eigenvalues of the 7x7 CORRELATION matrix of the trailing 20 daily returns {r_{i,tau}: tau in t-19..t} (correlation, not covariance - scale-free across pairs; the PC1 sign is irrelevant, only the share is used)
features_and_lags.reference_distribution: {s_tau} over the 252 decision days ending at t-1 (each s_tau computed on its own trailing-20 window; the reference excludes the current day)
features_and_lags.state_high: s_t >= 75th percentile of the reference distribution (preregistered top-quartile concentration)
features_and_lags.cum10_i_t: sum of {r_{i,tau}: tau in t-9..t} (10 returns ending at t)
features_and_lags.vol20_i_t: sample standard deviation of {r_{i,tau}: tau in t-19..t}
features_and_lags.noise_floor: pair i is skipped at t if |cum10_i_t| < 0.25 * vol20_i_t * sqrt(10) (the move must exceed a quarter of its own trailing 10-day scale; preregistered against sign-of-noise entries)
features_and_lags.direction: -sign(cum10_i_t) (FADE) for every pair passing the noise floor
features_and_lags.pit: all inputs are closes at or before the decision instant of t
features_and_lags.fitted_parameters: NONE - windows 20/252/10, percentile 75, floor multiplier 0.25, hold length 5 are preregistered constants; no training, no calibration, no threshold search anywhere

entry_exit_fills.entry_decision: at decision close t when state_high holds; all qualifying pairs entered simultaneously, direction = fade
entry_exit_fills.entry_fill: at the decision close of the FIRST decision day after the entry decision (next decision close); no same-bar fills
entry_exit_fills.exit_decision: at the decision close exactly 5 decision days after the entry fill
entry_exit_fills.exit_fill: at the decision close exactly 5 decision days after the entry fill (exit decision close is 4 decision days after entry fill; the position closes at the NEXT decision close)
entry_exit_fills.holding_profile: exposure spans exactly 5 decision-day close-to-close intervals per pair; 6 bps round trip at stress tier 2.0 against typical 5-day USD-factor ranges
entry_exit_fills.overlap_rule: one position per pair; while a position is open on pair i, new signals on i are SKIPPED (no stacking, no re-entry inside an open hold)
entry_exit_fills.fold_boundary_rule: any trade whose exit fill crosses a fold boundary is DROPPED from both books and counted

costs.frozen: 1.5 bps per side x {1.0, 1.5, 2.0} applied at every fill (entry and exit each one side, per pair)
costs.primary: stress tier 2.0 is the PRIMARY gate; tiers 1.0/1.5 reported for the cost ladder
costs.dual_books: book A = net of costs at the tier multiplier; book B = gross price-only (zero cost); the gross book must not invert the aggregate sign of the net book (house dual-book invariant)

anchor.definition: cross-pair fade when the dollar-factor concentration is high (state_high): enter -sign(cum10_i_t) on every pair passing the noise floor, per entry_exit_fills
anchor.identifying_claim: high factor concentration is the load-bearing state that pays the reversal premium

neighbour.differs_from_anchor_by_exactly_one_axis: state side: the COMPLEMENT state (s_t < the same 75th-percentile reference threshold) instead of high concentration; windows, floor, direction, clock, costs, folds identical
neighbour.role: identifiability: the anchor must out-earn the neighbour on the identifying metric, else the concentration state is not load-bearing and the edge is unconditional short-horizon reversal

control.kind: deterministic shifted-state placebo (causal control; this proposal is price-derived, so the mandatory control is a placebo that must RUN and kills mechanism-specificity when it reproduces the anchor)
control.definition: identical fade rule, identical floor, identical fills and costs, with the state series circularly shifted by +100 decision days: state_placebo_t = state_{t-100} (the state is a past value, so the placebo is trivially PIT-safe and fully deterministic - no randomness, no seeds)
control.role_and_falsifier: the placebo preserves the state's marginal distribution (same fraction of high days) while destroying its alignment with the price path; if the placebo reproduces the anchor (>= 0.5x the anchor's identifying metric, same sign), the timing claim is dead - the edge is unconditional fade, not dollar-factor concentration timing

falsification_rule.identifying_metric: pooled per-trade NET return (bps per unit notional) on the stress tier 2.0 book, pooled over all anchor-eligible events within each held-out fold evaluation
kill_conditions: placebo identifying metric >= 0.5 x anchor identifying metric with the same sign -> REJECT family (unconditional reversal, no concentration timing)
neighbour identifying metric >= anchor identifying metric -> REJECT family as the named mechanism (concentration not load-bearing)
anchor identifying metric <= 0 in ANY of the 3 held-out fold evaluations -> REJECT family (no fold rescue, no re-aggregation)
falsification_rule.no_rescue: no parameter, threshold, universe, hold, cost or gate change after any PnL is visible (preregistration); REJECT is a successful outcome

expected_failure_interpretation.anchor_fails_gates: no evidence that dollar-factor concentration pays a 5-day reversal premium after frozen costs; recorded as a falsified shape
expected_failure_interpretation.placebo_reproduces_anchor: the fade earns regardless of when concentration was high - the state carries no information; family dies as a concentration-timing claim
expected_failure_interpretation.neighbour_earns_like_anchor: short-horizon FX reversal is unconditional here; family dies as a dollar-factor claim and the unconditional reversal residual is recorded as a measured observation, NOT re-proposed without a new preregistration
expected_failure_interpretation.non_vacuity_failure: if warmup or fail-closed missing-day rules cannot fund the decision floors, the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed

fold_contract.warmup: 272 decision days (252-day rolling reference + 20-day state window + 1); the first eligible decision date is approximately 2019-05; fold machinery must account for the warmup (A9 measures)
fold_contract.folds: 3 contiguous temporal thirds of S0 by decision-day count; boundaries frozen by A1/A9 before any scored computation
fold_contract.drop_one: the IDENTICAL frozen rule (zero fitted parameters) is evaluated on each third as held-out; stability-only folds - the family passes only if the identifying metric is positive in each of the 3 held-out evaluations
fold_contract.no_empty_folds: if any arm has zero decisions in a held-out fold, that arm-fold is NOT_RUN and the family cannot pass (fail-closed)
fold_contract.boundary_trades: dropped and counted per boundary-crossing rule

gates.non_vacuity_floor: >= 30 decisions per arm per held-out fold (7-pair cross-section funds more events than P1's 4 pairs; A9 measures BEFORE selection; below floor = NOT_RUN)
gates.primary_profitability: pooled per-trade net mean > 0 at stress tier 2.0 in each held-out fold; per-fold PF and margins reported
gates.control_gate: placebo must RUN and must NOT reproduce the anchor (see falsification_rule)
gates.specificity_gate: anchor > neighbour on the identifying metric
gates.dual_book_invariant: gross book does not invert the aggregate net sign
gates.breakeven_bps: break-even bps per trade reported per arm vs the 6.0 bps tier-2.0 round trip (P-2 knife-edge discipline)
gates.margin_to_fail: every gate reports its margin to its failure threshold (P-2)
gates.usd_drift: mean and per-fold dispersion of the aggregate net USD factor exposure while in the high state - the claim is factor REVERSAL, so a persistent one-sided USD drift instead of oscillation around flat is reported as a mechanism inconsistency

each_decision_row_records: decision date and decision instant (16:00 America/New_York)
state inputs: s_t, the reference percentile value, cum10_i_t, vol20_i_t, noise-floor pass/fail with their exact input windows
entry/exit decision and fill dates, fill prices, side
costs booked per side at the tier multiplier and book (net/gross)
for the placebo arm: the shifted-state source date (t-100)
per_decision_evidence_traceability.recompute_contract: any data-semantics change (P-3) recomputes ALL THREE arms including the placebo - a control verdict does not survive a semantics change for free

ancestry_disclosure.session_structure_families: daily clock only; no session windows, opens, fades or range structures are computed (the forbidden fades are intraday session shapes)
ancestry_disclosure.vol_gated_carry: no policy-rate input of any kind; nothing in the state or direction touches rate differentials
ancestry_disclosure.commodity_bloc_risk_off: the state is a price-derived PCA share, not an event class; no risk-off conditioning exists
ancestry_disclosure.v5_release_window_position_avoidance: no calendar exists in this proposal at all - rho to any calendar-conditioned family should be structurally near zero; D2 measures
ancestry_disclosure.reversal_adjacency: the fade direction is reversal-shaped by design; the claim is NOT generic reversal but concentration-TIMED reversal, which is exactly what the neighbour and placebo falsify; D2 measures |rho| against the forbidden inventory

a9_open_questions: Snapshot close convention: confirm the staged daily snapshot cut aligns to (or maps fail-closed to) the 16:00 America/New_York decision close for all 7 pairs; if the staged cut differs, the mapping must be defined from the staged manifest BEFORE D2 - if unmappable, the proposal is UNAVAILABLE_FAIL_CLOSED.
Missing-day frequency: how often the fail-closed all-7-pairs rule blocks new entries.
Warmup interaction: confirm the 272-decision-day warmup leaves fold 1's held-out span and the S0 window non-degenerate; report first eligible date exactly.
Turnover and cost ceiling: expected simultaneous positions (up to 7) x 6-day holds vs the cost ladder; margin to break-even at tier 2.0.
PCA numerical stability: any dates where the 7x7 correlation matrix is singular or near-singular on standardized returns - the fail-closed no-entry rule must be counted, not silently absorbed.
